Regenerating this file is a reviewed decision (Mission 4, PV.1: pin run_financial_model ahead of vectorisation), not routine maintenance. A diff in this file must be justified field-by-field in the PR that produced it. REGENERATED 2026-08-29 (Mission 4, PV.5, founder-approved on CORRECTNESS grounds): src/core/finance/irr.py replaced an unbracketed Newton-Raphson-first solver with a domain-bounded bracket search + Brent's method (see irr.py::_brent_root), because Newton's correctness depended on a hardcoded starting guess that could silently converge to a different root -- or fail to converge -- depending on cash-flow shape. This regeneration moved ONLY `irr_10yr` in 33 of 34 cases (1 unchanged); every move was of order 1e-8 to 2.04e-7, well inside this harness's own 1e-6 tolerance philosophy, and NO other field in any case changed. See tests/core/finance/test_golden_forecasts.py's module docstring for the full before/after diff table and tests/core/finance/test_irr_brent_solver.py for the correctness properties the swap was for. REGENERATED 2026-08-29 (Mission 4, Gate V review, founder-approved on CORRECTNESS grounds): src/core/finance/engine.py::_forecast_core now appends a warning -- 'IRR undefined: no single discount rate solves NPV=0 within the search domain; treated as 0.00% for guardrail purposes.' -- to `warnings` whenever `irr()` returns None, instead of silently coalescing to 0.0 with no signal. This regeneration moved ONLY `units_1_horizon_10`'s `warnings` list (one entry appended); every other field of that case, and every field of the other 33 cases, is bit-identical to before. `units_1_horizon_10` has ALL-NEGATIVE cash flows in every year (see tests/core/finance/golden_cases.py), so NPV(r) < 0 for every r > -100% and no IRR root exists at ANY rate -- this is not a tolerance artifact or a solver quirk, it is the exact case the Gate V ruling was about: a previously-silent 0.00% sentinel, now made visible. See tests/core/finance/test_golden_forecasts.py's module docstring for the full before/after diff and tests/core/finance/test_irr_undefined_warning.py for the coverage.
